title: Croatian Frittata
description: A warm, fluffy, Croatian-inspired frittata perfect for a cozy breakfast. This recipe combines the richness of eggs with the flavors of Croatia.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt.
Add the cubed bread and chopped parsley to the bowl. Stir until well combined.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch pie plate or skillet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
